what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 3: How much of what a body in balance captures is its own emission?. SETTING (blocks 44-49; open PRs titled 'ail44: records with inertia', 'ail45: the wind law', 'ail47: transparent bodies', 'ail48: free capturing bodies are carried by the wind', 'ail49: the attraction is tied to growth'): a supplied clause, not adopted: a record's content is its direction of travel (sphere menu: a record with unit vector s steps to x + e_k with probability max(0, s.e_k)/sqrt 3; an occupied target exchanges contents; bonds re-draw their pair of contents uniformly on the momentum class at rate gamma); bodies are sets of solid sites that CAPTURE the records stepping onto them. ESTABLISHED: a capturing site takes up a record of content s in proportion to |s|_1 (1 to sqrt 3); over the uniform sphere <|s|_1> = 3/2 and <|s|_1 s_i s_j> = delta_ij/2, so in a first-harmonic wind (1 + 3 u.s)/(4 pi) every captured record brings u: the force K_0 Q_1 Q_2/r^2 with K_0 = sqrt3/(4 pi rho (1 - rho)) is the COLLISIONAL value; for independent records (gamma = 0, small density) the deficit behind a capturing site is the multinomial hitting probability of the directed walk with step frequencies |s_k|/|s|_1 and the force on a transparent site is (rho/(4 pi sqrt 3)) m |r|_1^2/r^2 with m = 1, 2, 4 off the coordinate planes, on a plane, on an axis (1 near an axis to 3 on the body diagonal, against 9/4 in every direction for the collisional law), with a remainder of relative order 1/r (deviation times |x|_1: -16, -24, +5.6 towards (1,2,2), (1,1,1), (28,1,1)); a FREE body (it streams as a record whose content is the mean content P/M of its records; captures join it) is CARRIED: content = wind's content u times the captured fraction of its mass (executed 0.78 to 0.97 of that), accelerated fall only while the gas inside the radius is small against 8 N_1/(3 pi^2 (1 - rho)); a body IN BALANCE (it re-emits what it captures through its faces with the cosine law) draws no inverse-square wind (exact flux identity), for independent records fills its shadow exactly, is still pushed along another body's wind with its gross capture (executed 0.75 +- 0.06 of the reference against 0.92 +- 0.05 between capturing bodies) and pulls nothing (executed 0.10 +- 0.07); q_1 = (8 pi/3)(1 - rho) G ties growth rate to pull. Simulators in probes/lib: inertial.py, inertial_porous_bodies.py, inertial_free_body.py (modes wind and fall), inertial_balanced.py (modes c and b per body). TASK: executed (uniform wind u, rho = 0.3): a pinned body of about 15 capturing sites scattered in a ball of radius 4, in balance, takes up 0.85, 0.83, 0.80 (+- 0.03) of u per captured record at gamma = 0, 1, 4, against 0.97 and 0.89 (gamma = 0, 1) when it only captures; ONE site in balance takes up 0.97 +- 0.03 against 1.00 +- 0.02. So the shortfall is the body capturing its own emissions again: they bring back what they took, not the wind's content. (a) Without scattering and at small density, compute the share exactly: a record emitted from a site with the cosine law is a directed walk with step frequencies |s_k|/|s|_1; the probability that it passes another given site x is the multinomial hitting probability integrated over the emitted contents; sum over the other sites of the body and average over random placements of N sites in a ball of radius R; give the predicted push per capture for N = 15, R = 4 and compare with 0.85/0.97. (b) With scattering at rate gamma the emitted record diffuses after about one mean free path; estimate the return probability to a body of N sites in a ball of radius R (capacity of the body against the capacity of the ball) and the resulting share; compare with 0.83/0.89 at gamma = 1. (c) For a solid ball of radius 3 at gamma = 1 (executed push 0.75 +- 0.06 of the reference against 0.92 +- 0.05 for a capturing ball) estimate the share of re-captured own emissions among its gross captures. check.py: your gamma = 0 share by direct sampling of directed walks.  DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/recapture-share-of-a-body-in-balance/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/recapture-share-of-a-body-in-balance/<name>/check.py"
